paragraphs: Mar Yehudah, in Rava's time. He found the people of Mavrakhta placing their eruv in the synagogue of Bei Agovar and told them to place the eruv farther inside the synagogue. [Rashi explains that he meant the far end.] Rava called him “Disputant!”: Eruvin 61b. Abaye said, “Mar Yehudah told me that in Mar Yochani's house [they ground grain with wild asses]”—Avodah Zarah 16b. In Avimi's name: Chullin 48a. He visited Rav Huna bar Yehudah's house [Eruvin 24a]. Rav Yosef; Rav Shmuel son of Rabbah bar bar Chana; and Rava: Kiddushin 58a. [The checked text has Mar Yehudah meet Rav Yosef and Rav Shmuel at Rabbah’s door, and the question later goes to Rabbah.]
